services.name: Sunset & Moët Sail (Adults only) Echo 2
services.desc: Come join us on the only public "Adults Only" sunset cruise in Key West, FL that serves real French champagne on board with style, and provides the best service off the island! Duration 2 Hours Treat yourself to a relaxing sail and the absolute best view of that very special Key West sunset over the open waters of the Gulf of Mexico! Your cruise will be serving 4 delectably rich cheeses surrounded by fresh fruits and berries, selected to not overpower our Champagnes and wines. Enjoy the best locally made smoked fish dip, crisps to provide a crunch, and fresh-baked crusty bread from an old town Key West bakery. All along with great refreshments included! services.name: Private Day Charter - Echo 2
services.desc: Treat yourself to the best of Key West - on the water! On our comfortable Catamaran Echo 2 private day charters, you can bring up to 19 lucky people (Echo's actually licensed for 28) for your amazing boating day in the Keys! The Echo 2 Crew will target your priorities for the day! We specialize in Shallow Water Snorkeling, Encounters with our local Wild Dolphin families, Sandbar parties (tide permitting), Wild life refuges tours - and lots of great Sailing and professional relaxing. The longer you go, the more you can do! On a 3-Hour Private Day Charter you would have time to target one activity, like a Wild Dolphin encounter OR Snorkeling OR a Sandbar Stop. services.desc: A private Sunset Sailing Cruise just for you! Treat yourself to the one of the best things to do in Key West - Champagne Sunset sailing! Our Private Sunset "cruise to nowhere" allows us time to turn off the engines and sailing wherever Mother Nature takes us. services.name: Wild Dolphins! Snorkel & Sailing Adventure
services.desc: Find out why the reviews are amazing! Sail with the Echo Crew. Experience Wild Dolphins where the play, feed and breed in the shallow tropical waters off Key West! Snorkel at our best shallow reefs and wrecks, selected by local knowledge and the speed /direction of the wind. Get wet, or relax onboard in the shade with a cool drink, or in the sun on our soft trampoline sun deck (dry snorkeling). Sail with sea turtles and tons of wildlife that's different everyday. Vessel features onboard Catamaran Echo! Soft trampoline sun deck – the “Black Beach” Mega swim noodles Sanitized snorkel equipment Fresh water shower Shaded and sunny seating Cabin with rest room Stereo sound with “Sirius”

faq.q: hat Should I Bring on my Echo trip?
faq.a: Towel (day trips), Sun screen on (no oil), Hat, Camera, Sunglasses (polarized best), a light jacket in winter, a small bag to secure your things, a few bucks and a Big Smile! To Protect Wild Dolphins, ECHO strictly follows all Federal Laws that state that it is illegal to touch, feed, chase, dive into or harass Marine Mammals. Thank you for choosing to cruise on Catamaran ECHO.
